title: (A) call-matched IHP control for B1 (C0_refit at the B1 NGSpice-call count; reverse: B1 at the C0_refit count); (B) g v2 with lambda fixed at 1 V (no nested selection) on the 9 measured DEV datasets
no_amendment: no amendment of the I19-1 TEST gate decisions (a755e18)
known_before: I22-1 IHP GMR(B1, C0_refit) 0.794/0.775/0.695/0.809 and call counts; stored lambda=1 V arms sky130 I15_2/lodo_sym_e1_l1, IHP 300 K I17_2/lodo_sym_e1_l1, TU Delft I18_2/lodo_*_sym_e1_l1 with their all-device means; selected rows = lambda=1 rows on lambda*=1 folds (difference 0); no paired GMR(fixed, selected) computed

part_A.call_unit: MeasProblem.n_sim of the held-out refit (incl. start, Jacobian columns, IRLS re-simulations, final re-simulation)
part_A.N_B1: I22_1/partA_ihp<T>/results.json n_sim.B1 per DUT (screen calls excluded, reported)
part_A.capped_refit: polish_capped: polish with at most N-1 calls inside polish; at the limit the running TRF round stops, remaining IRLS rounds skipped, best card kept

arms.C0_call: base box (12 active), max_nfev N_B1(d), call limit N_B1(d)
arms.B1_cap: I22-1 B1 (matched_nfev from 400), call limit N_C0(d) (secondary)

part_A.statistic: GMR(B1, C0_call), 18 DUTs, bootstrap 10000 seed 0, unit DUT

rule.survives: CI upper of GMR(B1, C0_call) < 1 at all 4 temperatures

implication.survives: B1 entered in the freeze draft as candidate IHP arm / gate option (user decision); frozen method unchanged
implication.not_shown: IHP B1 gain recorded as not separable from its 6x call budget; B1 not proposed; C0_call recorded as IHP call-matched control
implication.partial: reported per temperature; B1 open item, not proposed

reported: calls used, fraction of limit, binding count

validity.VA1: C0_refit rerun = stored rows (<=1e-12) and n_sim equal
validity.VA3: n_sim(C0_call) <= N_B1, n_sim(B1_cap) <= N_C0 per DUT

part_B.arm: fixed_l1: 5-member g v2 ensemble per outer fold, lambda = 1 V, selected recipe otherwise unchanged, same folds / training order / state as the selected arm; held-out refit max_nfev 400 irls 2 diff_step 0.01

reused.nist4: I20_1/lodo_nist4, the 17 devices with lambda* = 1 V

nist4: first nMOS and first pMOS (sorted tag) of the 17 reused
VB1_samples.on_fail: full rerun of that dataset's fixed_l1 arm

part_B.VB2_overlap: new IHP rows on lambda*=1 folds equal stored selected rows (<= 1e-9)
part_B.comparison_rows: plot_freeze_draft.datasets() (selected g v2, C0_refit, M_bias v1)
part_B.statistics: GMR(fixed_l1, selected), GMR(fixed_l1, C0_refit), GMR(fixed_l1, M_bias v1); device bootstrap 10000 seed 0, TU Delft 7-group cluster; pooled exp(mean ln GMR vs C0_refit) over 9

labels.vs_selected: fixed better (CI upper < 1) / selected better (CI lower > 1) / inconclusive; non-inferior iff CI upper < 1.05

rule.non_inferior: fixed_l1 non-inferior to selected on all 3 of G

implication.non_inferior: freeze draft lists fixed lambda 1 V as proposed replacement of nested selection (user decision)
implication.not_shown: nested selection stays; fixed arm reported as cost / accuracy trade-off

part_B.cost: held-out refit n_sim + 0 selection calls; ratio to C0_refit next to I22_1/cost.json

predictions.P5: fixed_l1 gain vs C0_refit on sky130, NIST lvt, NIST RT; not a gain at any IHP temperature
predictions.P6: fixed_l1 calls per held-out device within 1.1x of C0_refit on every dataset

order: queue: Part A x4, VB1 checks, IHP fixed_l1 x3, NIST lvt, NIST RT card, decide
decision, report, site claim, RESEARCH_LOOP outcome, freeze draft, memory; commit, push
compute_estimate: Part A ~30 min; Part B ~8.5 h (NIST RT card ~6 h) at 10 workers
